title: broadcast family_changed
description: Something of the family manager changed – a child's request (new, answered, expired, withdrawn), a release (started, ended, expired), a family manager's scope or notify targets, the family house settings or a kids rule set by a family manager. Admin UIs reload the family overview (GET /api/family) and open device pages; the integration treats it as refresh trigger. Ids only, no names or notes. Family managers get their own family_request / family_child_updated (targeted), children kids_request_state.

client_ids.description: Child or family manager devices concerned (sorted).

request_id.description: The request that changed, if any.
